excluded_text_hits.env: Log field, not an env command.
excluded_text_hits.false: Boolean values and case patterns; no external false invocation. Shell builtin remains.
excluded_text_hits.install: Android PackageManager operation and messages, not BusyBox install.
excluded_text_hits.ipaddr: Shell variable; ip addr is retained through the ip applet.
excluded_text_hits.ping: Root/installer daemon protocol request, not an ICMP command.
excluded_text_hits.reset: Script function argument and network error messages.
excluded_text_hits.resume: Argument to the native tty-relay-barrier operation.
excluded_text_hits.route: ip route subcommand and messages; ip route support remains enabled.
excluded_text_hits.script: Variable and log field; no terminal-recording command.
excluded_text_hits.split: AWK/jq functions and split APK messages.
excluded_text_hits.time: Log/JSON field; timing uses date, /proc/uptime and native tools.
excluded_text_hits.tree: SMB messages and native tool operations.
excluded_text_hits.ts: Shell translation function backed by DEX, not BusyBox timestamp.
excluded_text_hits.tty: /dev/tty device path, not a tty command.
excluded_text_hits.uptime: /proc/uptime data source, not an uptime command.

tar.reason: Core SHA-checked tool; installer explicitly skips BusyBox tar symlink.

find.reason: Core SHA-checked real executable; BusyBox installer does not replace existing files. GNU-specific -printf is used.

limitations: Static review does not prove runtime coverage or future script compatibility.
Custom hooks and unrelated module/release-maintenance scripts are outside this profile.
Requires the existing complete companion tool set, including GNU tar/find, zstd, jq, smbclient, speednative and DEX.
